body:
Good morning, my friend!

Mrs. Hannah needs a sled to pull hay across the snowy fields to her animals. I'm building one in the workshop today.

Could you fetch what I need from my shelves? I've written a note.
summary: Read Mr. Amos's note and fetch what he needs for the sled.

tasks.where: in Mr. Amos's workshop in the village
from the jug in your kitchen
